capabilities: Sync the current note or the whole vault to the blog repository
Detect and copy images referenced by synced notes
Preview git diffs and deselect files before committing
Select files through a searchable, collapsible directory tree
Show a git status panel of modified, added, and untracked blog files
disambiguation: Not a multi-device vault sync tool; it publishes notes into a specific FireFly Astro blog repository via Git.
extras: README is cut off mid-configuration section (the proxy settings list is incomplete); a Chinese documentation page is referenced but not included; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push notes and their images into an Astro blog's Git repository with review before committing.

relations.evidence: synchronizes Markdown notes and referenced images to your local FireFly Astro blog repository
for seamless pushing to GitHub or other remote hosts

summary: Git-based publisher that syncs vault Markdown notes and referenced images into a FireFly Astro blog repository with commits and pushes.
